Nuevo Laredo's new Museum of Science, Technology and Planetarium is now open to the general public, expanding the city's educational, cultural and tourism offerings for families across the region.

Mayor Carmen Lilia Canturosas Villarreal led the opening ceremony, which drew representatives from the business, academic and education sectors, members of the media and officials from all three levels of government. The museum's infrastructure was formally delivered on October 13, with Tamaulipas Governor Américo Villarreal Anaya in attendance.

Before opening to the public, the museum ran a first phase of scheduled visits by public-school students, used to test the facilities, train staff and prepare services.

The project represents an investment of more than 277.5 million pesos and covers more than 2,200 square meters. It includes a Science Pavilion, a Universe and Astronomy area, and an immersive planetarium set inside the dome of an elevated tank, with 52 seats, laser projection and surround sound.

The mayor said the project is the result of a shared vision between the municipal and state governments, and invited families from Nuevo Laredo and the entire region to visit the new space.

The museum is open Tuesday through Sunday, from 9:00 AM to 7:00 PM.

Source: La Voz de Tamaulipas, November 5, 2026.
